scope: Independent source review of current partial read-only API/storage surface; not full P5 completion or release acceptance

checks.operatorReadAuthority: Both GET routes use the native operatorOnly permission guard. No platform-only requirement is invented for the approved operator read grants.
checks.urlProjection: HTTP(S) only; credentials, query, fragment, non-root origins and non-string values are omitted. This surface performs no outbound URL requests.
checks.maintenance: Active only when expiresAt > generatedAt; exact boundary returns saved non-maintenance restoration state, retains stored state and performs no update.
checks.releaseFacts: No inferred build/deploy success; nullable version/commit/actor/CI/time and false CI remain distinct, archived apps excluded, count and page share one read-only repeatable-read transaction.
checks.schema: Exactly3 new tables; global unique stable app keys, separate platform-null/scoped flag uniqueness, structural scope constraints, target/operator/actor FKs, mandatory kill expiry/reason, finite positive revisions and nullable deployment facts.
checks.schemaClassification: Only registry/deploy facts are classified platform-owned; feature flags retain real operator FK, and the nonpartial archived app key is explicitly justified.
checks.snapshot: New unique ID chains to0088;0089 is provisional until landing.

limits: API/DB gates were coordinator-owned and running during review; no reviewer tests or runtime/live/Git actions were taken.
Current API tests directly pin8 HTTP/service cases and DB tests pin actual migration/constraints; source inspection does not claim their terminal result.

Flag lineage validation, writes, maintenance enforcement, expiry jobs, alerts, approvals and protected consumers remain explicitly held/unimplemented integration underQ24; no complete643 acceptance is claimed.
The URL reader does not enforce origin reachability or perform health probes; future writers/handoff integrations retain their separate allowlist and validation duties.
